tactical_insights: Julián Álvarez starts for Argentina, offering a chance to shine against Jordan's determined defense.
Argentina seeks a perfect group stage record, while eliminated Jordan plays for a historic World Cup farewell.
Scaloni's rotation strategy tests Argentina's depth against Jordan's 3-4-3 aiming for a historic upset.
